name: Wall of Slaughter: Battlefield
summary: The central war theater of the Wall of Slaughter, where Muramite squads clash with resistance enclaves amid Discord‑warped terrain.
description: The Battlefield is the chaotic heart of the Wall of Slaughter warfront. Muramite squads roam the terrain in coordinated strike groups, while resistance enclaves fight desperately to hold scattered defensive positions. Discord corruption saturates the land, creating unstable anomalies, warped terrain, and unpredictable planar surges. Siege debris, shattered barricades, and scorched earth mark the landscape. This zone represents the full fury of the Muramite war machine, where the outcome of each skirmish can shift the balance of the entire region.
